notes.title: Daffodil yellow: a few poems from an insect collector - DEMO SCENE
notes.notes:
[b][i]You are an insect collector looking for colors in old summer memories... 
[/i][/b]
 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38681701/18c7059fd71f59146c1c737d86bcaec80c2cb779.png[/img]

“Daffodil Yellow: a few poems from an insect collector” is a 3D game/interactive experience about the reconciliation between someone and a season. 

The story takes place at the very beginning of summer. This season makes the collector see everything in black and white. One day, after taking a nap, he turns into a butterfly. 

He will go through three memories that are dear to him, which took place during previous summers. Looking for a color in each of them, he will repaint his current summer.  

Each memory, each flower, each color has a meaning, creating an ambience through the music and the visuals.  

An abstract story without words, this project is about the different translations of a feeling. A precise feeling, told as visuals, sound, text and interactions through a 15-20
